t: Signature PX4 Autopilot: What PX4 Is: The Flight Stack
title: Signature PX4 Autopilot: What PX4 Is: The Flight Stack
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigPilot stack, Manon's original flight-control design. SigPilot mirrors the estimator-controller-mixer layering but every loop declares its rate and worst-case execution time, and the mixer carries a signed airframe file — the geometry of the vehicle it is allowed to fly. The Signature design refuses to arm if the airframe file's hash does not match the connected vehicle.
key_facts: Runs at hundreds of Hz on Pixhawk

console.log('PX4 stack:');
['sensors -> EKF2 estimate','position/attitude control','mixer -> motors','mission executive','MAVLink telemetry'].forEach(function(s){console.log(' '+s);});

t: Signature PX4 Autopilot: EKF2: Knowing Where You Are
title: Signature PX4 Autopilot: EKF2: Knowing Where You Are
description: SigPilot's estimator is the reckoner: same EKF formulation, but it publishes a health vector — per-sensor trust scores — alongside the estimate. The Signature design makes the health vector a first-class telemetry stream: the ground station sees not just 'position' but 'position, and how much we trust each sensor that built it'.
key_facts: Fuses IMU, GPS, baro, mag, optical flow
Per-sensor trust published with the estimate

t: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Control Loops: Position to Motors
title: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Control Loops: Position to Motors
description: SigPilot's loops are the reins: same cascade, but each loop publishes its tracking error, and the airframe file sets error limits per loop. The Signature design triggers an automatic controlled descent if any loop's error exceeds its limit for more than a second — the stack admits it is not in control before the ground does.
key_facts: Cascaded loops: position to body rates

t: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Safety: Failsafes and Return Logic
title: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Safety: Failsafes and Return Logic
description: SigPilot's failsafes are the covenants: same triggers, but each covenant's threshold is validated against the airframe's measured performance — return-energy math uses the actual measured current draw, not the datasheet. The Signature design logs every failsafe evaluation, so post-flight review shows which covenants were close to tripping.

t: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Tuning: From Oscillations to Locked-In
title: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Tuning: From Oscillations to Locked-In
description: SigPilot's tuning bench is the straightener: guided step tests per loop with pass/fail on tracking error and motor temperature. The Signature design records the tune with the airframe file — change a propeller and the stack demands re-tuning, because the tune belongs to the configuration, not the software.

t: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Airframe Configuration: Mixing and Geometry
title: Signature PX4 Autopilot: Airframe Configuration: Mixing and Geometry
